items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: then Eddie Scarf talked us out of it and I'll never forget that.

ctx.x: The next day we got the feeling we'll look for this Alan, Alan Walker, he was the guy we want to find because he was

setting these guys up and then Eddie Scarf talked us out of it and I'll never forget that. So imagine going through that? Now this girl, this girl now, this same girl I've been telling you about, she was in the party. She was the one who wanted to dance ballroom with me, I told her I don't do no ballroom dancing. I'm a tap dancer, not a ballroom dancer, don't know how to dance. And Buck don't know how to dance either. So neither one of us knew how to dance. Do you understand? So what, is she going to make us…

look at the age now. Look at the age you've got -- more gullible now at that age than you would be at manhood, you know what I mean? Got to get caught. Got to get caught. What do you think Buck and Bubbles climbed from, huh? Climbed from being able to evade. We evaded all the possibilities of doing -- well, I won't go into that. Let you have that.
